title: The Duet That Had Become a Solo
youtube_title: The Duet That Had Become a Solo | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Oren is just outside the fun, close to a duet being practiced as a solo. Dori changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Oren has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
